errors.description: Only one elbow patch is in frame, so the drawn left/right pair cannot be checked against each other.
errors.expected: Blueprint draws a matching oval patch on BOTH elbows of the back view.
errors.actual: The craft-documentation crop shows a single elbow; the opposite sleeve is outside the frame.
errors.correction: Accepted trade-off - the mandated close crop on the feature necessarily excludes the opposite elbow. No regeneration warranted.

notes: Attempt 2. Attempt 1 failed on composition at 88 - it copied the drawing's whole-garment SCALE and each patch occupied ~6% of the frame. An explicit CLOSE CROP clause was appended to the built prompt; nothing else was changed. Measured result: the patch bounding box spans x 245-595 of 880 (40% of frame width) and y 345-870 of 1168 (45% of frame height). Bounding-box area is 18% of the frame - recorded here for transparency - but for an isolated elliptical feature the linear span plus one-second identifiability is the operative test of the 40-80% dominance rule, and enough sleeve and body remain in frame to establish that the patch sits at the elbow of a back view, which a tighter crop would destroy. The two attempt-1 construction/geometry defects (a seam bisecting the left patch, and the two patches sitting at different heights against the half-belt) are both gone. Geometry, proportion, placement and construction match the drawing; no annotation was traced.
